# Opal Pettigrew

## Overview

- **Age:** 16  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v3 c5 P14](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0014)</sub>

## Appearance

Opal has curly brown hair, a radiant skin tone, and big, vivid blue eyes. She is tall, shapely, and considered extremely attractive by her peers. Later in her life, due to illness, she grows very slender, pale, and frail, though her cheeks remain flushed.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 c14 P4](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0004)_

## Personality

Opal is sunny, laughter-loving, and deeply preoccupied with boys, romance, and suitors. She enjoys being admired and likes to brag about her admirers, though her shallow romanticism masks a fear of serious matters. In the face of terminal illness, she struggles with fear and a desperate longing to live, eventually finding peace and reconciliation before her death.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 c14 P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011), [v3 c14 P17](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0017), [v3 c14 P31](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0031)_

## Traits

- Preoccupied with suitors and romance  <sub>[v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020)</sub>

- Fear of death  <sub>[v3 c14 P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011)</sub>

## Abilities

- Fancy needlework  <sub>[v3 c14 P3](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0003), [v3 c14 P32](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0032)</sub>

## Goals

- To enjoy life and have many suitors before marrying  <sub>[v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020)</sub>

## History

Opal attends Brierley School alongside Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke, where she is known for her flirting and dramatic tendencies. She later attends Regent's Academy to prepare for her entrance exams, where she joins the Story Club and participates in the school concert. After graduating, she takes a teaching position in West Welby. During her first winter teaching, she contracts a severe lung illness that forces her to give up her job. As her health deteriorates over the following summer, she remains in denial about her condition, continuing to talk about her suitors and future plans. Eventually, she confesses her deep fear of dying and her longing to live to Nell. Before passing away, she reconciles with her former friend Em White and dies peacefully in her sleep.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 c14 P3](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0003), [v3 c14 P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011), [v3 c14 P17](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0017), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030), [v3 c14 P33](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0033)_
